name: input_needs_shader
description: Q-14: a pass given an input its shader does not read. On a Blank pipeline project with a Cube and a Deferred geometry pass, gbuffer_albedo is dragged onto present, whose shader reads nothing. The engine refuses it (the pass's inputs and the shader's declarations disagree); the Frame Plan's status line says so in one line that says what to do, with Make a pass-through shader and Open the shader beside it. Make a pass-through shader writes shaders/present_pass_through.frag for the inputs and sends the inputs and the new shader in one edit: present then reads gbuffer_albedo and the viewport shows the G-buffer's colour.
